method.geometry: Drake convex rigid-scan signed hull distances; all production eligible pairs, including arm-body, self and opposite arm; adjacent rigid assemblies retain production exclusions
method.sweep: Piecewise joint-linear paths. Endpoints plus midpoint samples; each pair uses production lever travel bound, with unsampled relative point travel subtracted. At most4mm cover per pair. Query AABB distances over80mm retained as conservative lower bounds rather than exact convex distances.
method.comparison: Same scan reference, unchanged canonical coordinates, inactive joints held at reference; full warning sets retained rather than early return on first warning.

limitations: Positive driver directions are assumptions, not measured calibration.
September22 arm upright offsets and all inactive joints remain scan priors, not measured current physical posture.
Convex hulls and tool offsets remain provisional; cables, payload, real joint tracking deviation, and environment are outside this test.
The unchanged hanging->waypoint1 overlap is retained in this evidence. Passing new joined segments is not whole-route collision clearance or physical certification.
